summary: Russian forces advanced near Riasne and established control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka in Kharkiv region. Ukrainian forces reported destroying Russian UAVs and a locomotive, while Iranian strike plans against Ukraine were reportedly canceled. Multiple attacks targeted infrastructure across Ukraine including Sumy, Odessa, and Dnipro regions.
key_points: Russian forces advanced near Riasne in Kharkiv region (Source: @DeepStateUA/23718).
Russian UAV operators from Varyag brigade destroyed a locomotive hauling a freight train (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32137).
Iran had prepared a strike on Ukraine but canceled it after apologies, identifying three targets without details (Source: @eRadarrua/103901).
Six Russian FABs bombed the former Frunze Plant in Sumy, with fighting occurring 13-15 km from northern outskirts (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32142).
Ukrainian air defense intercepted 27 incoming ballistic missiles with only one Patriot interceptor (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32128).
A strike drone crashed into a beach crowd near Gelendzhik, Russia, killing six including three children (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32145).
Russian missiles destroyed the bridge between Slavyansk and Kramatorsk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32129).

Ukrainian President signed decrees appointing Rustem Umyorov as Head of the Security Service of Ukraine and Ihor Klymenko as Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council (Source: @DeepStateUA/23717).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are actively advancing in the Kharkiv region, establishing control over key settlements including Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka. The interception of 27 ballistic missiles indicates significant Ukrainian air defense capabilities, though the low success rate of Patriot interceptors raises concerns about future engagements. The crash of a Russian strike drone in Gelendzhik suggests potential vulnerabilities in Russian UAV operations and safety protocols.
sections.regional_response: Iranian preparations for a strike on Ukraine were reportedly canceled after diplomatic negotiations, indicating potential international pressure on regional actors. Ukraine's deployment of firefighters to France demonstrates international recognition of Ukrainian capabilities, though it raises questions about resource allocation during the ongoing conflict. The reported attacks on infrastructure in Sumy and the destruction of a historic church in Berislav highlight the broader humanitarian impact of the conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: The establishment of control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka by Russian forces represents a significant operational development in the Kharkiv sector. The interception of 27 ballistic missiles with only one Patriot interceptor suggests potential limitations in Ukrainian air defense systems. The crash of a Russian strike drone in Gelendzhik indicates possible operational vulnerabilities in Russian UAV operations. The reported destruction of the bridge between Slavyansk and Kramatorsk could impact Russian logistics and supply lines in the region.
